class: Application launches from stale deployment copies
symptom: Applications launched from an old architecture directory after fixes were committed and tested in the reliability checkout.
root_cause: Several independently started dashboards used their own working directories, and startup neither identified nor rejected an old loaded runtime.
why_tests_missed: Dashboard tests covered routes and actions, not startup against an already running dashboard from a different or changed source tree.
fix: Use one canonical entry point and port with a source-identity endpoint; startup reuses only the identical loaded checkout and refuses stale or unversioned servers.
prevention: Verify runtime identity after deployment and redirect legacy desktop entry points to the corrected canonical dashboard.
